about.en: LumiWave Protocol (LWP) is the Layer 1 mainnet of LumiWave, a South Korean Web3 company focused on games and intellectual-property licensing; LWP is the chain's native coin for gas, staking and governance, into which LumiWave's earlier LWA token is set to transition. It is distinct from LWA (CoinGecko onbuff).
